dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing of the lateral margins from the mid-section toward the posterior terminus.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Consistent medium slate-grey across the visible dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp gradient observed between the primary grey pigmentation and a localized white contrast disruption.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A prominent, high-contrast, linear white mark is visible on the posterior right side of the dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, elongated white mark or scar is visible on the right posterior side of the animal.
